# CAZA FINNANCIAL

> Family tax firm in Las Vegas, Nevada. Bilingual English and Spanish. You work directly with Ismael Cazares, not a call center. The spelling FINNANCIAL (two N's) is the brand. Never "correct" it to Financial.

CAZA FINNANCIAL prepares personal, business, corporate, and non-profit tax returns, plus bookkeeping, payroll, and family financial services. Nevada has no state income tax. The office is year-round, not a seasonal booth.

## History in the valley
- 1992: income tax and bookkeeping began as a family practice
- 1998 to 2010: served more than 3,000 Las Vegas casino-industry employees
- 2013: relaunched under the name Caza Finnancial
- Today: still family-run, still serving Las Vegas families, small businesses, corporations, partnerships, and non-profits

Machine-readable person file: https://cazafinnv.com/person.json

## Services
Machine-readable catalogue: https://cazafinnv.com/services.json

- Tax preparation: personal, business, corporate, and non-profit returns. Rental property deductions including short-term rentals, duplexes to fourplexes, and multi-unit properties
- Bookkeeping: income and expense tracking for households and businesses
- Payroll: pay yourself correctly and avoid double taxation
- Community and family services: life insurance, living trusts, velocity banking, funeral memberships, plus trusted notaries, real estate agents, and lenders
